verdict.rationale: OpenHands is explicitly open-source and documented to run locally, in Docker, on VMs, or 'anywhere you can run an agent server backend,' with a free local OSS tier distinct from the managed Cloud/Enterprise offerings, and Apptainer support for HPC/self-hosted sandboxing without root. This confirms core self-hosting is a first-class, documented path rather than cloud-only. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on report confirming a real self-hosted deployment and more detail on infra/resource requirements.
